title: Learning to adapt GR(1) specifications through degradation
abstract: arXiv:2609.12231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reactive synthesis is a powerful tool for generating correct-by-construction controllers from formal specifications. GR(1) is an assume-guarantee specification framework that enables efficient synthesis, allowing synthesised controllers to be used in a wide array of applications. The limitation of such controllers is that, should they encounter environment behaviour unspecified in the assumptions of the specification, the specified system guarantees are no longer ensured. Our work proposes an approach based on oracle-guided inductive synthesis to adapt the specification to be consistent with the observed assumption violation, while degrading system guarantees as little as possible to maintain realisability. Our methodology discovers multiple potential solutions, so we propose a preference criteria, based on the ability of the specification to enable robustness under adaptation. translated_title: 通过降级学习自适应GR(1)规约
translated_abstract: 反应式合成是一种强大的工具，能够从形式化规约中生成构造即正确的控制器。GR(1)是一种假设-保证规约框架，可以实现高效合成，使合成的控制器能够广泛应用于各种场景。此类控制器的局限性在于，当遇到规约假设中未规定的环境行为时，所规定的系统保证将不再得到确保。我们的工作提出了一种基于oracle引导归纳合成的方法，通过调整规约使其与观察到的假设违反情况保持一致，同时尽可能少地降级系统保证以维持可实现性。我们的方法能够发现多个潜在解决方案，因此我们提出了一种偏好准则，该准则基于规约在自适应调整下实现鲁棒性的能力。尽管我们的方法能够降级整个规约……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于oracle引导归纳合成的方法，通过尽可能少地降级系统保证来自适应调整GR(1)规约以应对观察到的假设违反情况，同时保持规约的可实现性。
en_tdlr: Proposes an oracle-guided inductive synthesis approach that adapts GR(1) specifications to be consistent with observed assumption violations while minimally degrading system guarantees to maintain realizability.
